basic_details.job_title: LTMGH Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline

post_wise_qualification.essential_qualification: As per qualifications laid down by National Medical Commission Regulations Date 30.06.2025 for minimum qualifications for teachers in medical institutions and amended from time to time. MS-CIT Passing Certificate. SSC or HSC Passed with Marathi subject.

qualification.details: If the MS-CIT and SSC or HSC with Marathi Subject Passing certificate is not available at the time of interview, it will be mandatory to submit it within three months for MS-CIT and six months for SSC or HSC with Marathi Subject from the appointment date.

how_to_apply: Obtain the prescribed application form from R. No 15, Cash Section (Head Clerk-Cash) of LTMG Hospital & Medical College on working days between 11.00 am to 3.30 pm.
Fill out the application form completely in your own handwriting with a recent passport-size photograph duly affixed.
Pay the application fee of Rs. 869 + 157 (GST 18%) Total – Rs. 1026/- at the cash section.
Attach all required attested photo copies of certificates and documents.
Submit the application by hand or post to reach the central dispatch section of LTMG Hospital & Medical College Sion, Mumbai 400 022 on or before 16.10.2026 up to 4.00 pm positively.
Attend the interview on 22.10.2026 at 02:30 PM at the Chambers of Dean, LTMG Hospital & Medical College Sion, Mumbai 400 022.

content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: The recruitment notification announces 1 total vacancy for the post of Assistant Professor under the following department:

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: If the MS-CIT and SSC or HSC with Marathi Subject Passing certificate is not available at the time of interview, it will be mandatory to submit it within three months for MS-CIT and six months for SSC or HSC with Marathi Subject from the appointment date.

rows.qualification: As per qualifications laid down by National Medical Commission Regulations Date 30.06.2025 for minimum qualifications for teachers in medical institutions and amended from time to time. MS-CIT Passing Certificate. SSC or HSC Passed with Marathi subject.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The remuneration for the Assistant Professor (Contractual) post is Rs. 1,10,000/- PER MONTH . The selected candidates are eligible only for the grant of Casual Leave and Special Casual Leave as per circular No. Director/M.E. & M.H/3644 dated 14.10.2022, and are not eligible for any other leave. This appointment is purely on a contract basis till 31.03.2027 and not on a regular basis. The appointed candidate can be discontinued at any time if not required, or can resign by submitting a notice of one month in advance. Services will be terminated if Assistant Professors become available on a regular basis through direct service.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for LTMGH Assistant Professor
content_sections.text: Obtain the prescribed application form from R. No 15, Cash Section (Head Clerk-Cash) of LTMG Hospital & Medical College on working days between 11.00 am to 3.30 pm. Fill out the application form completely in your own handwriting with a recent passport-size photograph duly affixed. Pay the application fee of Rs. 869 + 157 (GST 18%) Total – Rs. 1026/- at the cash section. Attach all required attested photo copies of certificates and documents. Submit the application by hand or post to reach the central dispatch section of LTMG Hospital & Medical College Sion, Mumbai 400 022 on or before 16.10.2026 up to 4.00 pm positively. Attend the interview on 22.10.2026 at 02:30 PM at the Chambers of Dean, LTMG Hospital & Medical College Sion, Mumbai 400 022.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Birth Certificate School/College Leaving Certificate Domicile Certificate Medical Educational Qualification Certificates & experience certificate MMC/MCI Registration Professional Indemnity Policy Secondary & Higher Secondary School Examination Mark List (Required Marathi Subject) For married female candidates: Marriage Certificate & Gazette Copy of Name Change (if applicable) PAN Card Aadhar Card Attested Xerox copies of undergraduate and Postgraduate Examination passing certificates if passed in more than 1 attempt MS-CIT passing Certificate No Objection Certificate from the previous employer (if in service)

faq.question: Q1. Is this Assistant Professor position permanent or on contract?
faq.answer: The appointment is purely on a contract basis till 31.03.2027 and not on a regular basis.

faq.question: Q2. What is the upper age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is not more than 38 years for Assistant Professor as on the date of the advertisement.

faq.question: Q3. What documents must be submitted with the application?
faq.answer: Candidates must submit attested photocopies of their Birth Certificate, School/College Leaving Certificate, Domicile Certificate, Medical Educational Qualification and experience certificates, MMC/MCI Registration, Professional Indemnity Policy, Secondary and Higher Secondary mark lists with Marathi subject, PAN Card, Aadhar Card, MS-CIT passing certificate, undergraduate and postgraduate passing certificates for multiple attempts, and a No Objection Certificate if in service.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee amount?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 869 plus 157 GST (18%), making a total of Rs. 1026/-.

faq.question: Q5. When and where is the interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The interview is scheduled for 22.10.2026 at 02:30 PM at the Chambers of Dean, LTMG Hospital & Medical College Sion, Mumbai 400 022.
